original_root_cause: FastBlockEncoder tracks firstAt+8ms but 100ms client/server lifecycle ticker was sole partial-parity flushing trigger; ack already uses independent 2ms timer.

architecture.shared_owner_wake_channel: 1 buffer per logical tunnel, only first/earlier pending deadline; send under TX mutex nonblocking
architecture.scheduler: one reusable time.Timer and one goroutine per ACTIVE real client/server logical owner, does not run for bare low-level Runtime.New tests
architecture.activation: client DialTunnelClient + server LifecycleServer.Run on accepted tunnel (not packet or lane)
architecture.runner: RunFECDeadlineSchedule, wakes on owner edge/replacement or absolute earliest deadline, parked when no pending groups; context/deadlineStop stops on close
architecture.scheduled_work: flushDuePartialParity only (owner.TickLane with generation fence then emit, may expire recv state), not full repair/health/lease/platform Tick
architecture.error_propagation: asynchronous parity send error accumulated and reported once by next periodic Runtime.Tick
architecture.periodic_tick: 100ms still executes health, repair, table sweeps, startup padding and service maintenance
architecture.receiver_path: separate goroutine, never runs on raw socket receive select loop
architecture.replacement_semantics: candidate notification cannot authorize fresh parity; promotion wakes timer for new active only, dormant/close cancels prior deadline

historical_oneparse_5205.scope: PASS_SCOPED_ACTIONS with one S2C 4068B missing under 20% artificial-loss stress, no kernel drops
